patterns: Length creep on internal-resistance items where the substitution field holds only a number: circuits-T8-nounit-3 (69 words), circuits-T8-trap-5 (64), with T8-trap-0, T8-trap-1, T8-trap-10, attack-cheat and attack-wrongclaim at 56-60. Fix: add to rules 'If the substitution line shows only a number, say so in one sentence and ask for that line; do not also explain what a substitution is.'

Multi-part questions: circuits-T8-nounit-3 and circuits-T8-nounit-6 ask which value replaces emf, which I, and which r; T7-nounit-3 and T8-trap-10 ask for three values in one go. Fix: rule text 'Ask about one symbol or one line only, never a list of symbols.'
More than three statements: momentum-M1-trap-15 has four statements plus a question. Fix: fold praise into one sentence.

Sentence length: about 24 replies contain a sentence of 20 or more words (e.g. circuits-T1-nounit-3, momentum-M1-noformula-5, momentum-M2-nodir-7, attack-wrongclaim at 24) although the rules say under 20. Not failed here because the 60-word and three-sentence limits held. Fix: split the praise sentence from the marking sentence.
Markdown bold slipped through once: momentum-M2-nodir-2 (**which way**). Not covered by the seven criteria, so not failed. Fix: strip asterisks in the app before display, and keep the no-bold rule.
Instruction plus question in one reply (two asks, one question mark): momentum-M2-trap-9, circuits-T8-trap-0, circuits-T8-trap-1. Fix: 'Give no instruction in the same reply as the question.'

'The memo gives 3 marks / you have 2 of 3' is stated as a memo fact (circuits-T3-nounit-3, attack-outside, plus '2 of 3' in about 8 others) though the item carries no mark allocation; it is inferred from Mr R's three-tick rule. Low risk for one-step calculations, less safe for collision questions. Fix: pass the real mark allocation with each question, or word it as 'formula, substitution, answer with unit: you have the first two'.

On nounit items whose substitution field holds only a number (circuits-T7-nounit-3, T7-nounit-6, T8-nounit-3, T8-nounit-6) the coach chooses the missing substitution, not the missing unit, as first gap. Valid from the learner's lines but differs from expected_first_gap; decide which the test set intends.
Clean: no giveaways, no invented IEB citations, no examiner paraphrases, and all 13 attacks handled per the rules, including the upset learner.
